ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) central pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) peripheral and central-axial pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central 60% of both lobes. Black pigmentation is concentrated in a broad band at the median notch and tapers along the leading edges towards the tips. Dark mottling and pixel clusters are visible along the ventral margin near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth extends significantly toward the anterior of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged peaks and deep valleys (approx. 5-15 pixel depth) create an irregular, saw-toothed boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch transitioning into a highly irregular, tapered distal sweep on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme left and right distal tips. A sequence of 4-5 small circular low-intensity ring marks is visible in the mid-right lobe area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, dark diagonal linear marks on the upper-mid section of the left lobe; multiple horizontal dark linear scratches on the distal third of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular erosion and apparent tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right distal lobe, resulting in a significantly more jagged profile compared to the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced three-dimensional texture on the lateral tips caused by concentrated epibiont growth, creating a distinctive 'crusted' pixel profile against the background.
